sports-betting app Tuesday, saying they have deliberately violated his publicity rights and trademarks by calling it "Bron" and using artificially generated images of him in their marketing.</description><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 00:46:27 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1117/r1747324_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Raptors say Kawhi
